 HR FAQ - Remote work
Document owner
Sofie Claes, HR Policy Manager
Last updated
2026-07-13
Question
How many days can I work from home?
Answer
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. At least 2 office days are required, including
the Tuesday team anchor day.
More info
See the policy on the HR SharePoint or contact HR.
